items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks; missed prior three games (torn hamstring). Was listed Q but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks; ready to roll per sources.
items.implication: QB1/stream option vs ATL; may limit designed runs initially.
items.opportunity: Full starter snaps/routes for CHI pass catchers like Odunze/Burden.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot after doctor consultations; out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start Sunday and beyond. Signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.why: Superficial blood clot in calf; extensive medical review Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts; long-term absence for Hurts (min 4 games). PHI pass game and RB committee disrupted.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for healthy top pass-catchers; thin RB depth opens snaps for backups like Blue/Pierce.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Completed 21-day practice window; limited practices but cleared for activation.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 upside in NE offense vs Jets; start if active despite rust risk.
items.opportunity: High target share expected; boosts Drake Maye.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday. Confirmed by beat/insiders as another game without him; Tyler Huntley starts.
items.implication: Huntley QB stream; Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume shifts; Henry still viable but script risk.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher target bump; RB committee stable.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (hamstring) alongside Hurts/Shipley. PHI RB depth thin; Dameon Pierce/Jaydon Blue elevated roles.
items.why: Hamstring; ruled out with multiple PHI injuries.
items.implication: Zero Saquon; McKee + thin RBs limit PHI run game; pass-catchers primary.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down to remaining backs; more dropbacks.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Cleared from IR; ETR had as Q.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out; potential snap share in BAL offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets behind Flowers/Andrews if scheme opens.

items.text: DK Metcalf (illness) removed from Steelers injury report; no designation for Sunday vs TB. Freiermuth added as Q (calf).
items.implication: Full WR1 role in thin PIT WR room; high target share confirmed by Levitan 2-WR projection.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Fri groin Q add. Probable-leaning: Caleb, DK Metcalf, Olave, Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) = heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice participation + designation reading; PIT depth chart thinness; PHI personnel.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely (GTD risk); Metcalf target monster in 2-WR; PHI WRs/TE startable with McKee; Warren stash watch.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes/targets spike; PHI pass-catcher volume; Henderson ankle doubt limits role if active.
items.conflict: Later Schefter Metcalf cleared (no designation); Brown activated.

items.text: Rashee Rice, Breece Hall, David Montgomery all OUT. Rice hamstring (bye insufficient); Hall quad; Montgomery groin.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; corroborated by reports.
items.implication: KC WR depth (Worthy/Hill stash); Jets Allen heavy; HOU Marks or committee.

items.text: IN: Ladd McConkey, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty (plus Johnston, Penix, MHJ). Cleared/no designation.
items.why: Removed from report or full clearance per ETR Sunday list.
items.implication: Full roles expected; Smith boosts PHI pass with McKee; McConkey WR3+; Lamb WR1; Jeanty RB opportunity.
items.opportunity: Snaps/routes/targets restored; reverse prior beneficiary fades.
corroboration: CBS: Smith back, McConkey off report

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI (WR6), George Kittle vs WSH (TE3), Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5). London/Golden usage bankable; Kittle/Evans WSH buffet; Kyren elite recent usage + soft run D.
items.why: Matchup + role/volume: WSH soft vs TE/WR; CHI for London; ARI leaky vs run + Kyren workload.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kittle TE1 upside, Kyren RB1, London WR2.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for London/Kittle; carries/goal-line for Kyren.

items.text: LOVE Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8, goal-line role), Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9, volume), Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2). Soft run Ds and high-scoring environments.
items.why: Volume + matchup (leaky run Ds); Purdy high total vs WSH.
items.implication: RB2/flex locks; Purdy QB1 stream. Note: Rhamondre boosted if Henderson limited/out.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone for RBs; pass volume for Purdy/Kittle stack.
items.conflict: Henderson Q status could split NE backfield.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28, tough D), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34, low feed), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18), J.K. Dobbins vs SEA (RB27, shut-down run D), Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23), Justin Herbert @ KC (QB25, low total).
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA elite pass/run D), shaky QB/volume, low team totals.
items.implication: Sit/fade; pivot to better spots. Herbert/Nix low floors.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH (ranks WR4). Commanders secondary buffet for pass-catchers; strong usage case.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH defense that has been nightmare for WRs; volume bankable.
